We expect to report topline data from the 16-week placebo-controlled portion of the EXACT study in mid-2027 and to report final data at 32 weeks by the end of 2027.

In October 2026, our IND received clearance to initiate the EXPRESS study and we expect to dose the first patient in the third quarter of 2027 and report 52-week topline data in the first half of 2029.
